SAP Functional Consultant/Manager/Senior Manager
Area of Expertise: Industry Specific (Consumer Goods & Services, Industrial & Automotive, Retail, Life Sciences or Aerospace& Defence)
Location: Europe (any)
Job description:
We are seeking a results-driven SAP consultant with experience working with Industry Specific clients (Consumer Goods & Services, Industrial & Automotive, Retail, Life Sciences and Aerospace& Defence) on to join our SAP system integration business. To ensure success as an SAP consultant, you should possess extensive knowledge of one of the industries, supply chain and sales business processes, IT system integration and the ability to accurately design and document SAP processes.
What’s in it for you?
This an opportunity to join a European team of senior SAP experts with a focus on “thought leadership, origination, sales and delivery of large transformation SAP programs across industries”
Unmatched opportunity to work with top industry client through human centric design, change management and innovation.
·Be supported to continue your SAP training and certifications – complimented with other Accenture Engineer & Architecture training initiatives
Key Responsibilities:
Deliver International/Global Projects within an agile environment.
explore and design automotive sales and manufacturing and logistics solutions powered by SAP technology.
Carry out Client Facing activities such as Pre-Sales/Origination, Discovery Workshops
Conduct SAP assessment and roadmap definition
Determine business needs via consultation, business analysis, and targeted observations
Carry out E2E solution Architecture and Lifecycle (including non-functional requirements and operations) management
Execute E2E Solution Design principles - Prototyping, Usability testing and data visualization literacy
You will bring a creative and innovative mindset to your work and clients while ensuring the highest quality work delivered on time.
Work with Agile and DevOps techniques and implementation approaches in the delivery
Develop and configuring customized SAP solutions
Deploy SAP solutions and ensuring smooth system integration
Perform thorough documentation of SAP processes and presenting progress reports
Keep abreast of the latest SAP offerings, updates, and developments
Necessary Knowledge / Skills:
What we’re looking for
Significant experience in large SAP driven transformation projects in one of the key industries- Consumer Goods & Services, Industrial & Automotive, Retail, Life Sciences or Aerospace & Defence
Possess a strong Functional knowledge of S/4 HANA transformations and a proven track record in an SAP Consultant position
Current industry knowledge
Knowledge of sales and supply chain business processes
Have exceptional communication skills and client facing experience.
SAP-accredited or certified experience
Proficiency in English, and knowledge of other European languages would be an asset
